description: Home page ("/") visual/behavior fixes (spec FIX 1-5). Independent of FEAT-002 (Navbar). Covers: equal-width 2-card tracking band + a spinning inner progress ring; the two missing 'discover more' CTAs (courses -> /courses, instructors -> /teachers); start-aligned offers band; FAQ expanded-answer spacing/typography; and an RTL/LTR logical-property audit of the Home sections and the ProgressTrackingCard/MediaInfoCard/OfferCard organisms. Keeps ar.json + en.json in sync.
steps: ProgressRing spinner (FIX 1b): in src/components/molecules/progress-ring.tsx add a decorative aria-hidden element that rotates continuously with `animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none` (tw-animate-css/Tailwind v4 `animate-spin` is available; add NO new @keyframes and do NOT touch tokens). Keep the wrapper role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max and the i18n accessible name (t('progress',{value})), keep the static {clamped}% center label, and support both state='default' and state='inverse' (color the spinner stroke-primary vs stroke-primary-foreground). Then update src/components/molecules/progress-ring.test.tsx: keep the role/aria/clamp tests and add one assertion that a decorative aria-hidden spinner element exists (e.g. an element with class containing 'animate-spin').

Tracking band (FIX 1a): in src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections/tracking-section.tsx reduce CARDS to TWO entries (first surface 'primary' navy, second surface 'secondary' teal) to match Figma node 624:3480 which shows exactly two equal-width cards, and change the row container class from `grid w-full gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3` to `grid w-full gap-6 md:grid-cols-2` so the two cards are equal width and fully inside the 1280 container with no overflow/carousel bleed.

Courses CTA (FIX 2): add key `viewAll` to home.homePage.courses in BOTH messages/ar.json (value "اكتشف اكثر") and messages/en.json (value "Discover more"), keeping the files in sync. In src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections/courses-section.tsx render a CTA below the grid mirroring instructors-section.tsx: `<Button asChild appearance="ghost" variant="primary" size="lg"><Link href={routes.courses}>{t("viewAll")}<RightArrowIcon aria-hidden /></Link></Button>`. Import Button from @/components/ui/button, RightArrowIcon from @/components/icons, routes from @/config/routes, Link from @/lib/i18n/navigation. Restructure the section container to center the CTA while keeping the heading block text-end (model exactly on instructors-section.tsx: section `items-center`, heading block `items-end text-end`).

Instructors CTA routing (FIX 2): in src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections/instructors-section.tsx the existing viewAll Button is a plain `<Button type="button">` with no navigation — wrap it with `asChild` and the i18n `Link` to routes.teachers so it routes, matching the courses CTA. Import Link from @/lib/i18n/navigation and routes from @/config/routes.

Offers alignment (FIX 3): verify the OfferCard content column (src/components/organisms/offer-card.tsx) and src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections/offers-section.tsx align heading/body/CTA to the inline-START (already items-end/text-end = start in RTL). If any non-start or physical alignment class is present, replace it with the logical start equivalent (items-start/text-start family). Do not add physical left/right.

FAQ answer styling (FIX 4): in src/components/molecules/accordion.tsx adjust ONLY the content panel `<div role="region" ...>` classes (currently `text-body px-4 pb-4 text-sm`) to add separation between the question and answer and apply paragraph-xsm typography: e.g. `text-body px-4 pb-5 pt-1 text-sm leading-5` plus a top border/margin separation per Figma. Do NOT alter the trigger button or any aria wiring (aria-expanded/aria-controls/role=region/aria-labelledby/hidden must stay).

RTL/LTR audit (FIX 5): grep the Home sections (src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections/*) and the organisms src/components/organisms/{media-info-card,offer-card,progress-tracking-card}.tsx for physical-direction classes (patterns: `\b(ml|mr|pl|pr)-`, `\b(left|right)-`, `text-left`, `text-right`). Replace any hit with the logical equivalent (ms/me/ps/pe, start/end, text-start/text-end). Known-good already-logical spots (MediaInfoCard `start-[30px]`, OfferCard `end-[-40px]`) need no change.
acceptance_criteria: ProgressRing renders a decorative aria-hidden element carrying `animate-spin` (and `motion-reduce:animate-none`); role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/min/max + the {value}% label are unchanged; `pnpm run test src/components/molecules/progress-ring.test.tsx` passes including the new spinner assertion.
The tracking band shows two equal-width cards (navy + teal) inside the 1280 container with no horizontal overflow (matches Figma 624:3480).
Courses and instructors sections each render a 'discover more' CTA that is an anchor to /courses and /teachers respectively; home.homePage.courses.viewAll exists in both ar.json and en.json.
Offers band heading/body/CTA sit at the inline-start in both RTL and LTR.

Opening a FAQ item shows the answer with clear padding/separation from the question in paragraph-xsm body color; aria-expanded toggles and the region remains labelled; faq-section + accordion tests pass.
grep for physical-direction classes across the audited Home files returns no matches.
verification: pnpm run typegen; pnpm run typecheck (exit 0)
pnpm run test (all green, incl. progress-ring.test.tsx, accordion.test.tsx, faq-section.test.tsx, messages-parity.test.ts)
grep_search for `\b(ml|mr|pl|pr)-`, `text-left`, `text-right` under src/app/[locale]/(public)/_sections and the three organisms returns no matches
figma get_screenshot on 624:3480 shows no visible drift for the tracking band, CTAs, offers alignment, and FAQ (RTL); reason about LTR mirroring
